intro:
Project work has run across eight states and five basins. The record includes deep gas development in northwest Louisiana and East Texas, oil-directed drilling in the southern Mississippi counties, stacked Marcellus and Utica programs in Pennsylvania and Ohio, shallow biogenic gas across northern Michigan, and utility-scale renewable siting in eastern Washington.

What carries between them is method rather than geography. The counties change and the formations change; the way the work gets done does not.
